official.stdout:
Usage: colab ssh [OPTIONS] [[-- CMD [ARGS]...]]...                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                
 Connect to a Colab runtime via SSH.                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                
 Bare ``colab ssh`` uses your only active session, or auto-creates one (like                                                                                    
 ``colab new``) if you have none, and opens a shell in ``/content``. With                                                                                       
 --proxy-mode it is a ProxyCommand-compatible WebSocket-stdio bridge; every                                                                                     
 flag above still applies (``-s NAME`` creates the session if missing,                                                                                          
 ``--gpu/--tpu`` set its accelerator, ``--rm`` stops it on disconnect).                                                                                         
 With ``-- CMD`` it runs CMD in ``/content`` on an existing session and                                                                                         
 exits with its status, using a PTY only when stdin and stdout are terminals.                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   [-- CMD [ARGS]...]      <list[str]>  Command to run on an existing session instead of a shell.                                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --session     -s      <str>   Session name                                                                                                                   │
│ --proxy-mode          <bool>  Act as an OpenSSH ProxyCommand-compatible WebSocket-stdio bridge (reads stdin, writes stdout). Use in ~/.ssh/config as         │
│                               `ProxyCommand colab ssh --proxy-mode -s SESS`. All flags below also apply here.                                                │
│ --identity    -i      <str>   SSH key (public `.pub` or private key path) whose public key is sent in the X-Colab-Ssh-Pubkey header (default: first of       │
│                               ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub, id_ecdsa.pub).                                                                                          │
│ --gpu                 <str>   GPU accelerator for a runtime created by this command (T4, L4, G4, H100, A100). Used when the session is auto-created.         │
│ --tpu                 <str>   TPU accelerator for a runtime created by this command (v5e1, v6e1). Used when the session is auto-created.                     │
│ --high-mem            <bool>  Request a high-RAM machine shape when this command auto-creates a runtime.                                                     │
│ --rm                  <bool>  Stop the runtime when the session ends. In interactive mode this applies only to a runtime `colab ssh` auto-created; in        │
│                               --proxy-mode it stops the bridged session on disconnect (ephemeral ~/.ssh/config host).                                        │
│ --help        -h      <bool>  Show this message and exit.                                                                                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: colab run [OPTIONS] {script} [script_args]...

official.stdout:
Usage: colab url [OPTIONS]                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                
 Print a browser URL that connects to an existing session.                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                
 Format: ``https://<host>/notebooks/empty.ipynb?dbu=<urlencoded path>#datalabBackendUrl=<host>/tun/m/<endpoint>``,                                              
 where the path is ``/tun/m/<endpoint>``. When opened, the Colab frontend                                                                                       
 skips ``/tun/m/assign`` and attaches the kernel to our existing VM.                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                
 Two backend-URL signals are embedded:                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                
 - ``?dbu=<urlencoded path>`` — the ``datalab_backend_url`` development                                                                                         
   query flag. The frontend resolves the value against                                                                                                          
   ``window.location.origin``.                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                
 - ``#datalabBackendUrl=<full URL>`` — the hash-fragment form. Some                                                                                             
   frontend code paths consult this first and ignore ``dbu``, so we                                                                                             
   emit both for robustness. The fragment value is a FULL URL (with                                                                                             
   scheme + host) and is intentionally NOT URL-encoded — browsers do                                                                                            
   not decode the fragment before passing ``location.hash`` to page                                                                                             
   JS, and Colab's hash parser expects the raw string.                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                
 The fragment's host always matches ``--host`` (the page origin), so                                                                                            
 Colab's same-origin enforcement on the embedded backend URL doesn't                                                                                            
 block the connection, and sandbox/dev users get a sandbox fragment                                                                                             
 automatically.                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --session  -s      <str>   Session name                                                                                                                      │
│ --host             <str>   Colab frontend host (origin) to use for the URL. The Colab frontend resolves `dbu` against `window.location.origin`, so this only │
│                            changes the page origin, not the embedded backend path.                                                                           │
│                            [default: https://colab.research.google.com]                                                                                      │
│ --open             <bool>  After printing the URL, also open it in the system browser. Off by default so the command remains pipeable (e.g. `colab url -s s1 │
│                            | xclip`).                                                                                                                        │
│ --help     -h      <bool>  Show this message and exit.                                                                                                       │

# Colab Rust 客户端

用 Rust 实现 Google Colab CLI 与 colab-ext 的功能合集。长期运行策略、VM 自动重建与任务检查点由任务脚本或外部调度器负责。当前提供多账户、OAuth、部分 ADC、本地存储，以及 Colab 控制面的会话查询、分配、释放、跨账户汇总、CCU 用量查询，Contents 文件操作，以及 Python/Notebook 与一次性脚本执行、历史查询和导出、VM 授权与官方 Drive 挂载、交互 REPL 与 Unix SSH；扩展 DriveFS 的独立凭据已接入，远端控制器已离线实现，挂载 CLI、默认 drivemount 策略与恢复入口已接入。原版 WebSocket 通信、心跳、状态与断线处理继续属于客户端范围。

## 构建与验证

本地应用不依赖 Python。`Cargo.toml` 声明 Rust 1.85+；当前在 macOS、Rust 1.99.1 验证，最低版本和其他平台尚待实测。

```sh
cargo build --locked
cargo run --locked -- --help
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked
cargo test --locked --no-default-features
# 以下只测试远端 Python 组件，不是本地客户端的运行依赖：
python3 -B tools/tests/test_drivefs_shim.py
python3 -B tools/tests/test_drivefs_controller.py
```

已实现子命令的官方/Rust 自动对比方法、报告及兼容差异见 [CLI 自动对比](docs/14-cli-comparison.md)。

默认启用系统凭据库。`--no-default-features` 可构建不包含原生凭据库的版本，适合离线开发；它不能替代系统凭据库的互操作测试。Linux 原生后端需要可用的 Secret Service。

## 多账户

使用独立配置目录体验本地功能，避免与 Python 客户端同时修改同一份配置：

```sh
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account add work --configure-only
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account use work
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account current
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account list --json
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account status --json
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account add storage --configure-only
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo -a work account set-drive storage
```

`account add` 默认登录，成功后尝试独立 Drive 授权并切换 active；`--no-drive` 跳过 Drive，`--no-use` 保留 active。`--url-only` 保存待完成授权后返回；只登记资料请显式加 `--configure-only`。详见 [联合授权与失败处理](docs/34-account-login-and-drive-consent-implementation.md)。支持 `rename`、`remove`、全局 Drive 默认绑定，以及中断事务的 `account repair`。删除只清理本地资料，不释放 VM。无 `--config-dir` 时使用 `~/.config/colab-cli`；环境变量为 `COLAB_CLI_CONFIG_DIR`。

`account status`（或 `acct status`）并发查询全部账户的 CCU、会话与 Drive 绑定，不受当前单账户选择限制；每行保留错误和已取得的余额，不能把退出 0 视为所有账户成功。它可刷新已有凭据，但不弹出交互登录；成功的会话查询会同步本地记录。`drive_ready` 只表示文件存在。详见 [账户状态说明](docs/29-account-status-implementation.md)。

## 认证

OAuth 需要用户提供 Google OAuth client 配置，支持 `installed`、`web` 或直接字段对象；仓库不包含 client secret。默认读取 `~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json`，也可用 `-c` 指定：

```sh
cargo run -- -a work -c /absolute/path/client.json account login --url-only
cargo run -- -a work account login --code 'AUTHORIZATION_CODE'
```

两次调用必须使用相同配置目录和账户。也可用 `--callback-url '完整回调URL'` 兑换并校验 state；尚无自动回调监听器。client、redirect、scope 是否被 Google 接受仍需真实授权验证。

`--token-storage auto|keyring|file` 控制凭据存储。`auto` 在系统凭据库写入失败后使用受限权限文件，并保持文件为权威来源；文件内容未加密。ADC 当前支持 `authorized_user`、`service_account`、`impersonated_service_account`、文件/URL 来源的 `external_account` 及 `external_account_authorized_user` JSON：

```sh
cargo run -- account add gcloud --configure-only --adc-file /absolute/path/application_default_credentials.json
cargo run -- account login gcloud
```

ADC 登录只验证取得 token，不代表具有 Colab 权限。service_account 使用未加密 PKCS#8 RSA 私钥签署 JWT，按 Colab 的公开 scope 集合交换 token，不回写密钥文件。impersonation 支持内嵌的用户或服务账户来源及 IAM delegates，源 token 与目标 token 分别缓存，不把源身份传给 Colab。external_account 支持 STS、可选 IAM 目标与 workforce user project，来源文件不会被回写。Workforce 用户 ADC 用客户端 Basic 认证刷新令牌，轮换只在当前进程缓存。ADC 在没有显式文件且默认 gcloud 文件不存在时可探测 GCE/GKE metadata；NO_GCE_CHECK=true 可禁用。Unix 可执行令牌来源需显式 GOOGLE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ALLOW_EXECUTABLES=1，支持非交互 JSON 和输出缓存。AWS aws1 支持环境快照和 EC2 IMDSv1/v2，生成签名主体供 Google STS 验证。当前不支持 domain-wide subject、其他 universe、证书来源、递归 impersonation 或 metadata mTLS。支持矩阵与离线证据见 [服务账户](docs/30-adc-service-account-implementation.md)、[IAM impersonation](docs/31-adc-impersonation-implementation.md)、[外部身份](docs/36-adc-external-account-implementation.md)、[Workforce 用户](docs/37-adc-workforce-user-implementation.md)、[metadata](docs/38-adc-metadata-implementation.md)、[可执行来源](docs/39-adc-executable-implementation.md) 与 [AWS](docs/40-adc-aws-implementation.md)。

## 会话控制面

先登录所选账户，再显式分配或释放 VM：

```sh
cargo run -- -a work new -s cpu-demo --json
cargo run -- -a work new -s gpu-demo --gpu T4 --high-mem
cargo run -- -a work sessions --json
cargo run -- status -s cpu-demo --json
cargo run -- -a work usage --json
cargo run -- stop -s cpu-demo
```

`sessions` 查询后端全部会话，未命名资源以 `?` 显示；`status` 显示本地命名会话的状态及上次执行信息。两者都会刷新本地 token，并裁剪已失效会话。失败分配可用相同硬件参数恢复；未暂存 endpoint 的普通分配可改用 `new -s NAME` 命名恢复，始终复用原 nbh，无需删除日志。`new` 仅使用显式/环境/active 账户，不按同名会话路由；`status -s` 和 `stop -s` 支持会话归属路由。JSON 和终端输出不包含 OAuth、proxy 或 XSRF token。

分配中断后，使用同一账户、名称和硬件参数重试 `new`；释放失败后重试 `stop`。逐账户操作日志保留 notebook identity 和清理意图，禁止手动删除；有待恢复操作时拒绝账户重命名或删除，包括 `--force`。详见 [控制面实现与恢复约定](docs/10-control-plane-implementation.md)。这些示例会操作真实 VM，离线回归使用 loopback HTTP；单次真实 CPU 验收见 [线上记录](docs/15-live-cpu-validation.md)。

## 文件操作与多账户汇总

以下命令只使用已有会话，不会自动分配 VM：

```sh
cargo run -- ls -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- upload ./local.bin content/remote.bin -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- download content/remote.bin ./copy.bin -s cpu-demo
EDITOR='code --wait' cargo run -- edit content/script.py -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- rm content/remote.bin -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- sessions --all --json
cargo run -- usage --all --json
```

上传/下载文件上限 32 MiB；下载校验成功后才原子替换本地文件。编辑只对 404 创建空文件，未修改时不上传；上传失败会保留本地编辑文件并显示恢复路径。`--all` 最多并发查询四个账户，逐账户保留结果或错误，不触发交互式登录。详细协议、兼容差异与未完成部分见 [文件接口与账户汇总实现](docs/11-contents-and-inventory-implementation.md)。

## 执行 Python 与 Notebook

```sh
printf 'x = 7\nprint(x)\n' | cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo -f task.py --env MODE=train --timeout 30
cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo -f interactive.py --allow-stdin --timeout 120
cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo -f experiment.ipynb --output-image plot.png
cargo run -- kernels -s cpu-demo --json
cargo run -- restart-kernel -s cpu-demo
```

exec 复用已有 kernel；普通命令退出保留 VM/kernel。Notebook 输出写入 `<stem>_output.ipynb`，失败时保留已有输出。默认超时表示本次相关消息的空闲期限；显式 `--allow-stdin` 需要 Unix 交互终端和 `-f`，允许远端 `input/getpass`，超时改为单次执行的总期限（包含输入等待）。0 为无限等待；断线或超时后不会自动重放代码。结果未知时保存消息 ID 并阻止新执行，先核查或显式重启 kernel。`stop` 可以从另一终端释放运行中的 VM。详见 [执行核心实现](docs/12-jupyter-and-execution-implementation.md)。

## VM 授权与官方 Drive 挂载

```sh
cargo run -- auth -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- drivemount -s cpu-demo /content/drive --upstream
```

这两个命令使用已有 VM 和所选算力账户。已授权流程可以无终端运行；需要人工输入时使用交互终端。auth 默认总期限 600 秒，drivemount 默认 30 秒，不隐式重放结果未知的执行。每次新操作使用独立 kernel，保留普通 exec 的变量环境；结果未知时使用 `automation-cleanup -s cpu-demo` 显式清理待恢复 kernel，创建 ID 未知时先用 kernels 核查。这里显式选择官方 Colab Drive 流程；专用协议与恢复约定见 [16](docs/16-colab-automation-implementation.md)。

`drivemount` 默认复用 `drive mount` 的独立 DriveFS 编排，采用计算账户绑定的 Drive 凭据，支持 `--readonly`、`--dry-run` 和跨账户。自动化建议加 `--no-fallback`；只有缺少凭据且没有恢复责任的普通交互终端可回退官方流程。显式 `--upstream` 或 `COLAB_DRIVE_DEFAULT=off` 选择官方策略，不能与 DriveFS 专用参数或受管挂载责任混用。两条路径都只操作已有 VM；现有 Drive 资料的真实 shim 挂载、读写、只读及云端清理已验证，首次 Google 授权、跨账户和长期刷新仍待验收，见 [真实验收](docs/65-live-drive-validation-and-recovery.md)。详见 [策略与测试](docs/28-drivemount-strategy-implementation.md)。

## 远端软件包安装

```sh
cargo run -- install -s cpu-demo numpy pandas
cargo run -- install -s cpu-demo -r requirements.txt
```

只操作已有 VM。requirements 在创建独立安装 kernel 前上传，执行结果未知时不自动重放；默认不限时，可用 `--timeout` 设置空闲期限。用法与未完成的真实安装验收见 [安装说明](docs/17-install-implementation.md)。

## 一次性脚本与历史

```sh
cargo run -- run --gpu T4 --env MODE=train -s training train.py --epochs 5
cargo run -- run --keep -s retained job.py
cargo run -- runs
cargo run -- run-cleanup RUN_UUID
cargo run -- log -s training --type execution --lines 10 --json
cargo run -- log -s training -o training.ipynb
```

run 的客户端选项放在脚本路径前，后续参数原样传给脚本。默认申请新 VM、执行并释放；--keep 保留 VM。清理失败保留 run 计划，可用 run-cleanup 恢复，恢复不会重放脚本。脚本非零退出码独立于清理结果；SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP 会请求取消等待并进入清理。历史还支持 `.md/.txt/.jsonl`，停止会话后仍可离线导出。详见 [run 与历史实现](docs/13-run-and-history-implementation.md)。

## 代码与文档

`src/` 包含账户、上下文、认证、凭据后端、存储、控制面协议、会话服务、Contents 和有界账户汇总模块；`tests/` 使用临时目录、内存凭据库和本地 HTTP 服务。完整默认/无默认特性测试结果见 [验收说明](docs/06-validation-and-open-questions.md)；远端 metadata、挂载控制器和包装器另有 41 项脚本测试通过，1 项 Linux 专属跳过，核心挂载 CLI 已接入，见 [挂载与租约说明](docs/24-drivefs-lifecycle-implementation.md)。另已执行单次真实 CPU 验收，范围与资源清理见 [记录](docs/15-live-cpu-validation.md)。

- [基础模块实现状态与边界](docs/09-foundations-implementation.md)
- [完整研究与实现规格](docs/README.md)
- [Rust 架构与实施顺序](docs/05-rust-architecture.md)
- [生命周期职责边界与历史方案](docs/08-supervision-and-recovery.md)

研究工具在 `tools/`，固定上游提交与离线证据在 `research/`。GitHub Actions 已配置 Linux/macOS 检查，尚未远程执行。

REPL 支持 `colab repl -s NAME` 和管道输入；Enter 提交，Ctrl-J/Alt-Enter 换行，EOF 或 `/quit` 退出。底层 WebSocket 每 60 秒发送协议心跳；这不保证 VM 不被回收。执行中断必须收到远端确认，断线或结果未知时禁止自动重放。详见 [REPL 与心跳实现](docs/18-repl-and-websocket-implementation.md)。

SSH 支持 `colab ssh -s NAME`、`colab ssh -s NAME -- CMD` 和 `--proxy-mode`。需要系统 OpenSSH；自动创建矩阵、--rm 清理与字节桥接约定见 [SSH 实现](docs/19-ssh-implementation.md)。Windows 原生 SSH 路径及真实 Colab SSH 验收仍待完成。

Drive 凭据支持 `drive consent/import/show/token/clear`，使用独立存储账户和私有文件；首次授权仍需用户同意。[授权与恢复说明](docs/20-drive-credentials-implementation.md)。远端控制器和私密输入适配已有离线实现；核心挂载 CLI 与本地恢复计划已接入，现有资料的真实读写/只读和上传后卸载已验证。各次失败、显式恢复及剩余缺口见 [真实验收](docs/65-live-drive-validation-and-recovery.md)，实现接口见 [控制器说明](docs/22-drivefs-controller-implementation.md)。

`drive status -s cpu-demo --path /content/drive --json` 只读核查已有 VM，不需要 Drive 凭据，可与未知挂载操作隔离运行。`drive probe-cleanup -s cpu-demo` 只清理其待恢复核查 kernel；创建结果未知时需先核实 ID，再显式传 --kernel-id。只读恢复见 [只读与凭据回收](docs/23-drivefs-probe-and-recovery.md)，核心挂载/卸载编排见 [挂载与租约](docs/24-drivefs-lifecycle-implementation.md)。

`drive mount -s cpu-demo --dry-run` 预览核心挂载参数；去掉 --dry-run 执行，`drive umount -s cpu-demo` 卸载并回收轮换凭据。`drive leases` 离线列出受管引用；VM 已释放但记录仍在时用 `drive lease-cleanup --endpoint ...`，服务端确认不存在后才清理。

DriveFS 也支持 `--from-env`、实验性 `--cli-token`、`--user-id/--email` 和 `--drive-extra=--flag`；输入优先级、持久化与轮换保护见 [来源与参数说明](docs/25-drivefs-inputs-implementation.md)。

`colab ext doctor --json` 只读检查本地账户、认证文件与恢复记录，不查询钥匙串或网络；`ext version` 显示内建能力，`ext install` 兼容旧入口但不修改 Python 环境。见 [诊断说明](docs/26-extension-diagnostics-implementation.md)。

`colab url -s work` 只读取本地会话并输出单行浏览器 URL，`--open` 才启动系统浏览器。`whoami --json` 会刷新所选账户并查询 Google 身份；`readme/README` 和 `skill/SKILL` 输出内嵌文档。详见 [工具命令说明](docs/27-utility-commands-implementation.md)。

`colab update --manifest URL` 检查原生发行，`--install` 校验并安装，`--status` 与 `--rollback` 离线核查和恢复。发行渠道选择 GitHub Releases，仓库为 [deluxebear/colabcli-rust](https://github.com/deluxebear/colabcli-rust)，尚未发布；可用 `COLAB_CLI_UPDATE_MANIFEST` 指定可信清单；预计清单地址为 `https://github.com/deluxebear/colabcli-rust/releases/latest/download/colab-update.json`。支持 Linux GNU/macOS 的 x86_64、aarch64，默认请求期限 30 秒。见 [更新与发行候选](docs/32-native-update-and-release-implementation.md)。

`colab --show-completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell|pwsh` 离线生成补全脚本；显式 `--install-completion bash|zsh|fish` 才安装到用户 shell 配置。`drive status --drive-account NAME` 可展示存储账户选择与本地凭据文件是否存在，仍只用计算账户查询 VM。见 [补全与状态选择](docs/35-completion-and-drive-status-implementation.md)。

`account list --json` 输出账户数组及本地认证、Drive、会话摘要；`current --json` 包含来源和文件路径。它们不刷新令牌或打开钥匙串；auto/keyring 缺少文件时 ready=null，表示未检查。[输出与兼容边界](docs/41-account-inventory-implementation.md)。

账户 `use/set-drive/rename/remove` 的确认输出与常见参数错误已按合并版对齐，写回保留账户顺序。新建 `--token-storage file` 重命名/删除仅处理文件；`account repair` 遵循日志中的后端策略，没有策略字段的旧日志仍需完成原有跨后端清理。[变更与恢复说明](docs/42-account-mutations-implementation.md)。

账户清单和变更会先校验根级 `-a`/`COLAB_ACCOUNT`；无效全局资料不会继续修改配置。`colab -a personal account set-drive storage -a training` 中，personal 是全局上下文，training 是绑定目标，两者独立。[选择规则与验证范围](docs/43-account-selection-implementation.md)。

`sessions/usage --json` 现在输出合并版账户行；`--all --json` 输出这些行的数组，包含 assignments、usage 和 error。账户查询失败也返回 JSON 和退出码 0，脚本必须检查 error；原有 kernel/执行详情仍可用 `status --json` 查询。[结构迁移与对照](docs/44-merged-inventory-implementation.md)。

配置原生发行源后，交互式账户清单/变更和 sessions/usage/status/new/stop 每日检查一次更新；2 秒请求超时，失败不阻断命令。settings.json 设置 `enable_update_check=false` 可关闭。JSON、管道与 SSH 不显示提示。[每日检查与缓存](docs/45-daily-native-update-implementation.md)。

执行输出现在按 Markdown、HTML、纯文本的顺序显示可读文本；JSON 与 Notebook 保留原始 MIME bundle。转换不抓取链接或执行网页脚本。[富文本显示与对照](docs/46-rich-text-output-implementation.md)。

文本执行输出支持终端 PNG 的 Kitty 分包协议；非终端不发送图片控制序列。没有 `--output-image` 时，PNG/JPEG 会保存到权限 0600 的系统临时文件，并输出路径，退出后保留供用户使用。JSON 不生成默认图片。[图片显示与清理责任](docs/47-terminal-image-output-implementation.md)。

Jupyter、SSH WebSocket 与 HTTP 请求支持环境变量指定的 HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT、SOCKS5/SOCKS5h 代理及 `NO_PROXY`；例如 `ALL_PROXY=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080`，socks5 在本地解析目标域名，socks5h 交给代理解析。代理拒绝时返回错误，不退回直连。HTTPS 代理与目标端各自验证 TLS 证书。WebSocket 暂不支持 SOCKS4 或系统代理自动发现。[HTTP 选择规则](docs/48-websocket-http-proxy-implementation.md)与 [SOCKS5 验收边界](docs/49-websocket-socks-proxy-implementation.md)，以及 [HTTPS 代理与双层 TLS](docs/50-websocket-https-proxy-implementation.md)。

JPEG 输出现可在 TTY 中转换为 PNG 内联显示，默认/显式图片文件、JSON 与 Notebook 仍保留原始 JPEG；解码或超限错误只影响显示。[转换与限制](docs/51-jpeg-terminal-projection-implementation.md)。

ADC 现按 `GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT` 和凭据文件的 `quota_project_id` 传递 `x-goog-user-project`，并区分 IAM 来源与目标项目；不会把该头传给 runtime REST/WS。[配额项目规则](docs/52-adc-quota-project-implementation.md)。

控制面客户端现保留账户绑定的凭据来源，请求前按需续期；会话清单和用量查询在 401 后最多刷新重试一次，分配、释放等操作不因 401 自动重放。[续期与失败恢复](docs/53-control-credential-refresh-implementation.md)。

# Colab CLI

A command-line interface for Google Colab. Provision high-performance CPU, GPU, and TPU runtimes, execute local code, manage remote files, and orchestrate automated cloud pipelines — directly from your terminal.

Designed to support seamless developer productivity, headless automation, and AI agent integrations.

[Demo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/<UUID>)

> [!NOTE]
> **Platform support:** the Colab CLI currently supports **Linux and macOS** only. Windows is not supported at this time.

> [!TIP]
> Looking for in-notebook, interactive agent-assisted coding instead of a terminal workflow? See the [Colab MCP Server](https://github.com/googlecolab/colab-mcp).

---

## Key Features

* **Instant VM Provisioning:** Spin up CPU, GPU (T4, L4, G4, H100, A100), or TPU (v5e1, v6e1) runtimes in seconds.
* **Robust Code Execution:** Run local Python scripts, Jupyter Notebooks (`.ipynb`), or piped `stdin` code; launch interactive REPLs or SSH shells (`colab ssh`).
* **Ephemeral Job Runner (`colab run`):** Provision a fresh VM, execute a local script with forwarded arguments, retrieve output files, and automatically tear down the runtime in a single command.
* **Activity-Based Liveness:** Sessions stay alive as long as the kernel is active, with the Colab backend automatically maintaining liveness.
* **Seamless Workspace Automation:** Mount Google Drive, authenticate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) credentials, and install dependencies with high-performance `uv` package management.
* **State & Log Archival:** Inspect local session states or export interactive history logs to standard Jupyter Notebooks, Markdown, or structured JSONL.

---

## Installation

Install the package using `uv` (recommended) or standard `pip`:

```bash
# Using uv (recommended)
uv tool install google-colab-cli

# Using pip
pip install google-colab-cli
```

---

## Quick Start

Run a CPU-based VM runtime, execute some code, and clean up:

```bash
# 1. Provision a new session
colab new

# 2. Execute code from stdin
echo 'print("Hello from Google Colab!")' | colab exec

# 3. Stop and release the VM resource
colab stop
```

> [!NOTE]
> When only one session is active, you can omit the `-s, --session` option;
> the CLI automatically knows it.


---

## Command Index

Run `colab <command> --help` to view specific options, defaults, and detailed help.

### Session Management
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab new [-s NAME] [--gpu GPU] [--tpu TPU] [--high-mem]` | Allocate a new CPU, GPU, or TPU VM runtime (optionally high-RAM) |
| `colab sessions` | List all active sessions currently active on the backend |
| `colab status [-s NAME]` | Display hardware, machine shape, status, and local metadata for active sessions |
| `colab restart-kernel [-s NAME]` | Restart the active session's Jupyter kernel |
| `colab stop [-s NAME]` | Terminate a session VM and release its resources |
| `colab url [-s NAME] [--open]` | Print or open a browser URL connecting to the active session |

### Execution
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab run [--gpu GPU] [--tpu TPU] [--high-mem] [--keep] SCRIPT [ARGS...]` | Run a local script on a fresh VM, forwarding arguments, then release it |
| `colab exec [-s NAME] [-f FILE] [--output-image PATH]` | Execute Python code from stdin, a local `.py` file, or a `.ipynb` notebook |
| `colab repl [-s NAME] [--output-image PATH]` | Start an interactive Python REPL on the VM (exits cleanly on piped EOF) |
| `colab ssh [-s NAME] [--proxy-mode] [-i KEY] [--gpu GPU] [--tpu TPU] [--high-mem] [-- CMD ...]` | Open an SSH shell to the runtime over WebSocket, run a one-shot remote command (`-- CMD`), or act as an OpenSSH `ProxyCommand` bridge for IDE remote-dev |

### File Operations
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab ls [-s NAME] [PATH]` | List remote files on the VM |
| `colab upload [-s NAME] LOCAL REMOTE` | Upload a local file to the VM filesystem |
| `colab download [-s NAME] REMOTE LOCAL` | Download a remote file from the VM filesystem |
| `colab rm [-s NAME] PATH` | Delete a remote file on the VM filesystem |
| `colab edit [-s NAME] PATH` | Edit a remote file in-place using your local `$EDITOR` |

### Automation & Utilities
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab auth [-s NAME]` | Authenticate the VM for GCP services (BigQuery, GCS, etc.) |
| `colab drivemount [-s NAME] [PATH]` | Mount Google Drive on the VM (default: `/content/drive`) |
| `colab install [-s NAME] [-r FILE \| PKG...]` | Install packages on the VM using `uv` (falls back to `pip`) |
| `colab log [-s NAME] [-n N] [-o FILE]` | View or export session history (`.ipynb`, `.md`, `.txt`, `.jsonl`) |
| `colab usage` | Show account compute-unit usage rate and balance |
| `colab pay` | Open the Colab subscription page to manage compute units |
| `colab version` | Print the installed version of the CLI |
| `colab update [--install]` | Check for a newer release (and optionally upgrade the CLI in place) |

### Global Options
* `--auth {oauth2,adc}` — Authentication strategy for the Colab API (default: `adc`).
* `-c, --client-oauth-config PATH` — Path to public OAuth client credentials configuration (default: `~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json`).
* `--config PATH` — Path to local session metadata storage (default: `~/.config/colab-cli/sessions.json`).
* `--logtostderr` — Direct debug logging output to stderr.

---

## Practical Examples

### Accelerator Training with Checkpoint Retrieval

Provision an A100 GPU, install requirements, run a local training script, retrieve the resulting model weights, and terminate the VM:

```bash
colab new -s trainer --gpu A100
colab install -s trainer torch transformers
colab exec -s trainer -f train.py
colab download -s trainer checkpoints/model.bin ./model.bin
colab stop -s trainer
```

### Workspace Notebook Execution with Drive Integration

Mount Google Drive, run a local notebook against the VM kernel (outputs are written back into `report_output.ipynb`), export a Markdown log of the execution, and clean up:

```bash
colab new -s analysis
colab drivemount -s analysis
colab exec -s analysis -f report.ipynb
colab log -s analysis -o execution_log.md
colab stop -s analysis
```

---

## Usage Notes

* **Machine shape:** Use `--high-mem` with `colab new`, `colab run`, or `colab ssh` (when auto-creating a runtime) to request a high-RAM machine shape. Requires Colab Pro or Pro+ entitlement for supported accelerators (CPU, T4, A100, etc.). L4 and TPU runtimes ignore this flag because they only offer one shape. Machine shape is shown in `colab sessions` and `colab status`.
* **TTY Requirements:** `colab repl` and interactive `colab ssh` expect a local TTY. When running inside automated scripts or pipelines, pipe stdin to `colab repl` (e.g., `echo "print(1)" | colab repl`) to trigger its non-interactive mode, or run one-shot shell commands with `colab ssh -s NAME -- CMD` (e.g., `colab ssh -s NAME -- ls /content`); pass untrusted values as separate arguments (after `--` where the program accepts it), since a single argument is a remote shell line. `colab ssh` needs a local `ssh` client and key, so where it can't work (no client or key, a tool not on the minimal ssh environment's `PATH`, or the runtime's concurrent SSH connections in use), pipe the commands to `colab exec` with IPython's `!` prefix (e.g., `echo '!ls /content' | colab exec`); each `!` line is its own shell and IPython expands `{expr}` and `$name` in it, so start a multi-line script with `%%bash` and keep untrusted text out of `!` lines.
* **Transparent Code Execution:** When calling `colab exec -f file.py`, the CLI reads the file locally and transmits its content to the remote kernel. You do not need to manually upload files before execution.
* **Storage & State Paths:** Session tokens and metadata are stored at `~/.config/colab-cli/sessions.json`. Global CLI settings are located at `~/.config/colab-cli/settings.json`. These can be customized or isolated via the global `--config` flag.

### Ephemeral Accelerator Jobs

Use `colab run` to run a local script on dedicated hardware without manual session lifecycle management. The CLI handles provisioning, script execution, and immediate VM teardown automatically:

```bash
# Run train.py on a T4 GPU and release the VM on completion
colab run --gpu T4 train.py
```

### Shebang Execution Support

To execute a local file directly on a remote accelerator, place the `colab run` interpreter in the shebang line:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env -S colab run --gpu L4 --keep
import torch

print("L4 GPU Available:", torch.cuda.is_available())
print("Device Name:", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))
```

Make the script executable (`chmod +x script.py`) and run it: `./script.py`. The `--keep` option tells the CLI to preserve the session VM on completion so you can re-execute or inspect logs.

---

## Deep Dive Documentation

For comprehensive architectural overviews and deep-dives into specific CLI sub-systems, refer to the detailed documentation:

* [Session Management Architecture](docs/01_session_management.md)
* [Interactive & Non-Interactive Execution Design](docs/02_execution_and_interactive.md)
* [File Management & Jupyter Contents API](docs/03_file_management.md)
* [Authentication Providers & VM Automation](docs/04_automation_and_utility.md)
* [Ephemeral Job Runner Design](docs/05_run_command.md)

To view interactive walkthroughs of eleven real-world automated scenarios, check out the [Demo Walkthroughs](docs/demos.md).

---

## Contributing

Feedback and contributions are welcome! Please read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.

---

## Legal & Privacy

See Colab's [Terms of Service](https://research.google.com/colaboratory/tos_v6.html) and the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy), which apply to usage of this CLI.

# Colab Rust 客户端

用 Rust 实现 Google Colab CLI 与 colab-ext 的功能合集。长期运行策略、VM 自动重建与任务检查点由任务脚本或外部调度器负责。当前提供多账户、OAuth、部分 ADC、本地存储，以及 Colab 控制面的会话查询、分配、释放、跨账户汇总、CCU 用量查询，Contents 文件操作，以及 Python/Notebook 与一次性脚本执行、历史查询和导出、VM 授权与官方 Drive 挂载、交互 REPL 与 Unix SSH；扩展 DriveFS 的独立凭据已接入，远端控制器已离线实现，挂载 CLI、默认 drivemount 策略与恢复入口已接入。原版 WebSocket 通信、心跳、状态与断线处理继续属于客户端范围。

## 构建与验证

本地应用不依赖 Python。`Cargo.toml` 声明 Rust 1.85+；当前在 macOS、Rust 1.99.1 验证，最低版本和其他平台尚待实测。

```sh
cargo build --locked
cargo run --locked -- --help
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked
cargo test --locked --no-default-features
# 以下只测试远端 Python 组件，不是本地客户端的运行依赖：
python3 -B tools/tests/test_drivefs_shim.py
python3 -B tools/tests/test_drivefs_controller.py
```

已实现子命令的官方/Rust 自动对比方法、报告及兼容差异见 [CLI 自动对比](docs/14-cli-comparison.md)。

默认启用系统凭据库。`--no-default-features` 可构建不包含原生凭据库的版本，适合离线开发；它不能替代系统凭据库的互操作测试。Linux 原生后端需要可用的 Secret Service。

## 多账户

使用独立配置目录体验本地功能，避免与 Python 客户端同时修改同一份配置：

```sh
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account add work --configure-only
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account use work
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account current
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account list --json
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account status --json
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo account add storage --configure-only
cargo run -- --config-dir /tmp/colab-rust-demo -a work account set-drive storage
```

`account add` 默认登录，成功后尝试独立 Drive 授权并切换 active；`--no-drive` 跳过 Drive，`--no-use` 保留 active。`--url-only` 保存待完成授权后返回；只登记资料请显式加 `--configure-only`。详见 [联合授权与失败处理](docs/34-account-login-and-drive-consent-implementation.md)。支持 `rename`、`remove`、全局 Drive 默认绑定，以及中断事务的 `account repair`。删除只清理本地资料，不释放 VM。无 `--config-dir` 时使用 `~/.config/colab-cli`；环境变量为 `COLAB_CLI_CONFIG_DIR`。

`account status`（或 `acct status`）并发查询全部账户的 CCU、会话与 Drive 绑定，不受当前单账户选择限制；每行保留错误和已取得的余额，不能把退出 0 视为所有账户成功。它可刷新已有凭据，但不弹出交互登录；成功的会话查询会同步本地记录。`drive_ready` 只表示文件存在。详见 [账户状态说明](docs/29-account-status-implementation.md)。

## 认证

OAuth 需要用户提供 Google OAuth client 配置，支持 `installed`、`web` 或直接字段对象；仓库不包含 client secret。默认读取 `~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json`，也可用 `-c` 指定：

```sh
cargo run -- -a work -c /absolute/path/client.json account login --url-only
cargo run -- -a work account login --code 'AUTHORIZATION_CODE'
```

两次调用必须使用相同配置目录和账户。也可用 `--callback-url '完整回调URL'` 兑换并校验 state；尚无自动回调监听器。client、redirect、scope 是否被 Google 接受仍需真实授权验证。

`--token-storage auto|keyring|file` 控制凭据存储。`auto` 在系统凭据库写入失败后使用受限权限文件，并保持文件为权威来源；文件内容未加密。ADC 当前支持 `authorized_user`、`service_account`、`impersonated_service_account`、文件/URL 来源的 `external_account` 及 `external_account_authorized_user` JSON：

```sh
cargo run -- account add gcloud --configure-only --adc-file /absolute/path/application_default_credentials.json
cargo run -- account login gcloud
```

ADC 登录只验证取得 token，不代表具有 Colab 权限。service_account 使用未加密 PKCS#8 RSA 私钥签署 JWT，按 Colab 的公开 scope 集合交换 token，不回写密钥文件。impersonation 支持内嵌的用户或服务账户来源及 IAM delegates，源 token 与目标 token 分别缓存，不把源身份传给 Colab。external_account 支持 STS、可选 IAM 目标与 workforce user project，来源文件不会被回写。Workforce 用户 ADC 用客户端 Basic 认证刷新令牌，轮换只在当前进程缓存。ADC 在没有显式文件且默认 gcloud 文件不存在时可探测 GCE/GKE metadata；NO_GCE_CHECK=true 可禁用。Unix 可执行令牌来源需显式 GOOGLE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ALLOW_EXECUTABLES=1，支持非交互 JSON 和输出缓存。AWS aws1 支持环境快照和 EC2 IMDSv1/v2，生成签名主体供 Google STS 验证。当前不支持 domain-wide subject、其他 universe、证书来源、递归 impersonation 或 metadata mTLS。支持矩阵与离线证据见 [服务账户](docs/30-adc-service-account-implementation.md)、[IAM impersonation](docs/31-adc-impersonation-implementation.md)、[外部身份](docs/36-adc-external-account-implementation.md)、[Workforce 用户](docs/37-adc-workforce-user-implementation.md)、[metadata](docs/38-adc-metadata-implementation.md)、[可执行来源](docs/39-adc-executable-implementation.md) 与 [AWS](docs/40-adc-aws-implementation.md)。

## 会话控制面

先登录所选账户，再显式分配或释放 VM：

```sh
cargo run -- -a work new -s cpu-demo --json
cargo run -- -a work new -s gpu-demo --gpu T4 --high-mem
cargo run -- -a work sessions --json
cargo run -- status -s cpu-demo --json
cargo run -- -a work usage --json
cargo run -- stop -s cpu-demo
```

`sessions` 查询后端全部会话，未命名资源以 `?` 显示；`status` 显示本地命名会话的状态及上次执行信息。两者都会刷新本地 token，并裁剪已失效会话。失败分配可用相同硬件参数恢复；未暂存 endpoint 的普通分配可改用 `new -s NAME` 命名恢复，始终复用原 nbh，无需删除日志。`new` 仅使用显式/环境/active 账户，不按同名会话路由；`status -s` 和 `stop -s` 支持会话归属路由。JSON 和终端输出不包含 OAuth、proxy 或 XSRF token。

分配中断后，使用同一账户、名称和硬件参数重试 `new`；释放失败后重试 `stop`。逐账户操作日志保留 notebook identity 和清理意图，禁止手动删除；有待恢复操作时拒绝账户重命名或删除，包括 `--force`。详见 [控制面实现与恢复约定](docs/10-control-plane-implementation.md)。这些示例会操作真实 VM，离线回归使用 loopback HTTP；单次真实 CPU 验收见 [线上记录](docs/15-live-cpu-validation.md)。

## 文件操作与多账户汇总

以下命令只使用已有会话，不会自动分配 VM：

```sh
cargo run -- ls -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- upload ./local.bin content/remote.bin -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- download content/remote.bin ./copy.bin -s cpu-demo
EDITOR='code --wait' cargo run -- edit content/script.py -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- rm content/remote.bin -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- sessions --all --json
cargo run -- usage --all --json
```

上传/下载文件上限 32 MiB；下载校验成功后才原子替换本地文件。编辑只对 404 创建空文件，未修改时不上传；上传失败会保留本地编辑文件并显示恢复路径。`--all` 最多并发查询四个账户，逐账户保留结果或错误，不触发交互式登录。详细协议、兼容差异与未完成部分见 [文件接口与账户汇总实现](docs/11-contents-and-inventory-implementation.md)。

## 执行 Python 与 Notebook

```sh
printf 'x = 7\nprint(x)\n' | cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo -f task.py --env MODE=train --timeout 30
cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo -f interactive.py --allow-stdin --timeout 120
cargo run -- exec -s cpu-demo -f experiment.ipynb --output-image plot.png
cargo run -- kernels -s cpu-demo --json
cargo run -- restart-kernel -s cpu-demo
```

exec 复用已有 kernel；普通命令退出保留 VM/kernel。Notebook 输出写入 `<stem>_output.ipynb`，失败时保留已有输出。默认超时表示本次相关消息的空闲期限；显式 `--allow-stdin` 需要 Unix 交互终端和 `-f`，允许远端 `input/getpass`，超时改为单次执行的总期限（包含输入等待）。0 为无限等待；断线或超时后不会自动重放代码。结果未知时保存消息 ID 并阻止新执行，先核查或显式重启 kernel。`stop` 可以从另一终端释放运行中的 VM。详见 [执行核心实现](docs/12-jupyter-and-execution-implementation.md)。

## VM 授权与官方 Drive 挂载

```sh
cargo run -- auth -s cpu-demo
cargo run -- drivemount -s cpu-demo /content/drive --upstream
```

这两个命令使用已有 VM 和所选算力账户。已授权流程可以无终端运行；需要人工输入时使用交互终端。auth 默认总期限 600 秒，drivemount 默认 30 秒，不隐式重放结果未知的执行。每次新操作使用独立 kernel，保留普通 exec 的变量环境；结果未知时使用 `automation-cleanup -s cpu-demo` 显式清理待恢复 kernel，创建 ID 未知时先用 kernels 核查。这里显式选择官方 Colab Drive 流程；专用协议与恢复约定见 [16](docs/16-colab-automation-implementation.md)。

`drivemount` 默认复用 `drive mount` 的独立 DriveFS 编排，采用计算账户绑定的 Drive 凭据，支持 `--readonly`、`--dry-run` 和跨账户。自动化建议加 `--no-fallback`；只有缺少凭据且没有恢复责任的普通交互终端可回退官方流程。显式 `--upstream` 或 `COLAB_DRIVE_DEFAULT=off` 选择官方策略，不能与 DriveFS 专用参数或受管挂载责任混用。两条路径都只操作已有 VM；现有 Drive 资料的真实 shim 挂载、读写、只读及云端清理已验证，首次 Google 授权、跨账户和长期刷新仍待验收，见 [真实验收](docs/65-live-drive-validation-and-recovery.md)。详见 [策略与测试](docs/28-drivemount-strategy-implementation.md)。

## 远端软件包安装

```sh
cargo run -- install -s cpu-demo numpy pandas
cargo run -- install -s cpu-demo -r requirements.txt
```

只操作已有 VM。requirements 在创建独立安装 kernel 前上传，执行结果未知时不自动重放；默认不限时，可用 `--timeout` 设置空闲期限。用法与未完成的真实安装验收见 [安装说明](docs/17-install-implementation.md)。

## 一次性脚本与历史

```sh
cargo run -- run --gpu T4 --env MODE=train -s training train.py --epochs 5
cargo run -- run --keep -s retained job.py
cargo run -- runs
cargo run -- run-cleanup RUN_UUID
cargo run -- log -s training --type execution --lines 10 --json
cargo run -- log -s training -o training.ipynb
```

run 的客户端选项放在脚本路径前，后续参数原样传给脚本。默认申请新 VM、执行并释放；--keep 保留 VM。清理失败保留 run 计划，可用 run-cleanup 恢复，恢复不会重放脚本。脚本非零退出码独立于清理结果；SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP 会请求取消等待并进入清理。历史还支持 `.md/.txt/.jsonl`，停止会话后仍可离线导出。详见 [run 与历史实现](docs/13-run-and-history-implementation.md)。

## 代码与文档

`src/` 包含账户、上下文、认证、凭据后端、存储、控制面协议、会话服务、Contents 和有界账户汇总模块；`tests/` 使用临时目录、内存凭据库和本地 HTTP 服务。完整默认/无默认特性测试结果见 [验收说明](docs/06-validation-and-open-questions.md)；远端 metadata、挂载控制器和包装器另有 41 项脚本测试通过，1 项 Linux 专属跳过，核心挂载 CLI 已接入，见 [挂载与租约说明](docs/24-drivefs-lifecycle-implementation.md)。另已执行单次真实 CPU 验收，范围与资源清理见 [记录](docs/15-live-cpu-validation.md)。

- [基础模块实现状态与边界](docs/09-foundations-implementation.md)
- [完整研究与实现规格](docs/README.md)
- [Rust 架构与实施顺序](docs/05-rust-architecture.md)
- [生命周期职责边界与历史方案](docs/08-supervision-and-recovery.md)

研究工具在 `tools/`，固定上游提交与离线证据在 `research/`。GitHub Actions 已配置 Linux/macOS 检查，尚未远程执行。

REPL 支持 `colab repl -s NAME` 和管道输入；Enter 提交，Ctrl-J/Alt-Enter 换行，EOF 或 `/quit` 退出。底层 WebSocket 每 60 秒发送协议心跳；这不保证 VM 不被回收。执行中断必须收到远端确认，断线或结果未知时禁止自动重放。详见 [REPL 与心跳实现](docs/18-repl-and-websocket-implementation.md)。

SSH 支持 `colab ssh -s NAME`、`colab ssh -s NAME -- CMD` 和 `--proxy-mode`。需要系统 OpenSSH；自动创建矩阵、--rm 清理与字节桥接约定见 [SSH 实现](docs/19-ssh-implementation.md)。Windows 原生 SSH 路径及真实 Colab SSH 验收仍待完成。

Drive 凭据支持 `drive consent/import/show/token/clear`，使用独立存储账户和私有文件；首次授权仍需用户同意。[授权与恢复说明](docs/20-drive-credentials-implementation.md)。远端控制器和私密输入适配已有离线实现；核心挂载 CLI 与本地恢复计划已接入，现有资料的真实读写/只读和上传后卸载已验证。各次失败、显式恢复及剩余缺口见 [真实验收](docs/65-live-drive-validation-and-recovery.md)，实现接口见 [控制器说明](docs/22-drivefs-controller-implementation.md)。

`drive status -s cpu-demo --path /content/drive --json` 只读核查已有 VM，不需要 Drive 凭据，可与未知挂载操作隔离运行。`drive probe-cleanup -s cpu-demo` 只清理其待恢复核查 kernel；创建结果未知时需先核实 ID，再显式传 --kernel-id。只读恢复见 [只读与凭据回收](docs/23-drivefs-probe-and-recovery.md)，核心挂载/卸载编排见 [挂载与租约](docs/24-drivefs-lifecycle-implementation.md)。

`drive mount -s cpu-demo --dry-run` 预览核心挂载参数；去掉 --dry-run 执行，`drive umount -s cpu-demo` 卸载并回收轮换凭据。`drive leases` 离线列出受管引用；VM 已释放但记录仍在时用 `drive lease-cleanup --endpoint ...`，服务端确认不存在后才清理。

DriveFS 也支持 `--from-env`、实验性 `--cli-token`、`--user-id/--email` 和 `--drive-extra=--flag`；输入优先级、持久化与轮换保护见 [来源与参数说明](docs/25-drivefs-inputs-implementation.md)。

`colab ext doctor --json` 只读检查本地账户、认证文件与恢复记录，不查询钥匙串或网络；`ext version` 显示内建能力，`ext install` 兼容旧入口但不修改 Python 环境。见 [诊断说明](docs/26-extension-diagnostics-implementation.md)。

`colab url -s work` 只读取本地会话并输出单行浏览器 URL，`--open` 才启动系统浏览器。`whoami --json` 会刷新所选账户并查询 Google 身份；`readme/README` 和 `skill/SKILL` 输出内嵌文档。详见 [工具命令说明](docs/27-utility-commands-implementation.md)。

`colab update --manifest URL` 检查原生发行，`--install` 校验并安装，`--status` 与 `--rollback` 离线核查和恢复。发行渠道选择 GitHub Releases，仓库为 [deluxebear/colabcli-rust](https://github.com/deluxebear/colabcli-rust)，尚未发布；可用 `COLAB_CLI_UPDATE_MANIFEST` 指定可信清单；预计清单地址为 `https://github.com/deluxebear/colabcli-rust/releases/latest/download/colab-update.json`。支持 Linux GNU/macOS 的 x86_64、aarch64，默认请求期限 30 秒。见 [更新与发行候选](docs/32-native-update-and-release-implementation.md)。

`colab --show-completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell|pwsh` 离线生成补全脚本；显式 `--install-completion bash|zsh|fish` 才安装到用户 shell 配置。`drive status --drive-account NAME` 可展示存储账户选择与本地凭据文件是否存在，仍只用计算账户查询 VM。见 [补全与状态选择](docs/35-completion-and-drive-status-implementation.md)。

`account list --json` 输出账户数组及本地认证、Drive、会话摘要；`current --json` 包含来源和文件路径。它们不刷新令牌或打开钥匙串；auto/keyring 缺少文件时 ready=null，表示未检查。[输出与兼容边界](docs/41-account-inventory-implementation.md)。

账户 `use/set-drive/rename/remove` 的确认输出与常见参数错误已按合并版对齐，写回保留账户顺序。新建 `--token-storage file` 重命名/删除仅处理文件；`account repair` 遵循日志中的后端策略，没有策略字段的旧日志仍需完成原有跨后端清理。[变更与恢复说明](docs/42-account-mutations-implementation.md)。

账户清单和变更会先校验根级 `-a`/`COLAB_ACCOUNT`；无效全局资料不会继续修改配置。`colab -a personal account set-drive storage -a training` 中，personal 是全局上下文，training 是绑定目标，两者独立。[选择规则与验证范围](docs/43-account-selection-implementation.md)。

`sessions/usage --json` 现在输出合并版账户行；`--all --json` 输出这些行的数组，包含 assignments、usage 和 error。账户查询失败也返回 JSON 和退出码 0，脚本必须检查 error；原有 kernel/执行详情仍可用 `status --json` 查询。[结构迁移与对照](docs/44-merged-inventory-implementation.md)。

配置原生发行源后，交互式账户清单/变更和 sessions/usage/status/new/stop 每日检查一次更新；2 秒请求超时，失败不阻断命令。settings.json 设置 `enable_update_check=false` 可关闭。JSON、管道与 SSH 不显示提示。[每日检查与缓存](docs/45-daily-native-update-implementation.md)。

执行输出现在按 Markdown、HTML、纯文本的顺序显示可读文本；JSON 与 Notebook 保留原始 MIME bundle。转换不抓取链接或执行网页脚本。[富文本显示与对照](docs/46-rich-text-output-implementation.md)。

文本执行输出支持终端 PNG 的 Kitty 分包协议；非终端不发送图片控制序列。没有 `--output-image` 时，PNG/JPEG 会保存到权限 0600 的系统临时文件，并输出路径，退出后保留供用户使用。JSON 不生成默认图片。[图片显示与清理责任](docs/47-terminal-image-output-implementation.md)。

Jupyter、SSH WebSocket 与 HTTP 请求支持环境变量指定的 HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT、SOCKS5/SOCKS5h 代理及 `NO_PROXY`；例如 `ALL_PROXY=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080`，socks5 在本地解析目标域名，socks5h 交给代理解析。代理拒绝时返回错误，不退回直连。HTTPS 代理与目标端各自验证 TLS 证书。WebSocket 暂不支持 SOCKS4 或系统代理自动发现。[HTTP 选择规则](docs/48-websocket-http-proxy-implementation.md)与 [SOCKS5 验收边界](docs/49-websocket-socks-proxy-implementation.md)，以及 [HTTPS 代理与双层 TLS](docs/50-websocket-https-proxy-implementation.md)。

JPEG 输出现可在 TTY 中转换为 PNG 内联显示，默认/显式图片文件、JSON 与 Notebook 仍保留原始 JPEG；解码或超限错误只影响显示。[转换与限制](docs/51-jpeg-terminal-projection-implementation.md)。

ADC 现按 `GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT` 和凭据文件的 `quota_project_id` 传递 `x-goog-user-project`，并区分 IAM 来源与目标项目；不会把该头传给 runtime REST/WS。[配额项目规则](docs/52-adc-quota-project-implementation.md)。

控制面客户端现保留账户绑定的凭据来源，请求前按需续期；会话清单和用量查询在 401 后最多刷新重试一次，分配、释放等操作不因 401 自动重放。[续期与失败恢复](docs/53-control-credential-refresh-implementation.md)。

> **Platform support:** the Colab CLI currently supports **Linux and macOS** only. Windows is not supported at this time.

> [!TIP]
> Looking for in-notebook, interactive agent-assisted coding instead of a terminal workflow? See the [Colab MCP Server](https://github.com/googlecolab/colab-mcp).

---

## Key Features

* **Instant VM Provisioning:** Spin up CPU, GPU (T4, L4, G4, H100, A100), or TPU (v5e1, v6e1) runtimes in seconds.
* **Robust Code Execution:** Run local Python scripts, Jupyter Notebooks (`.ipynb`), or piped `stdin` code; launch interactive REPLs or SSH shells (`colab ssh`).
* **Ephemeral Job Runner (`colab run`):** Provision a fresh VM, execute a local script with forwarded arguments, retrieve output files, and automatically tear down the runtime in a single command.
* **Activity-Based Liveness:** Sessions stay alive as long as the kernel is active, with the Colab backend automatically maintaining liveness.
* **Seamless Workspace Automation:** Mount Google Drive, authenticate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) credentials, and install dependencies with high-performance `uv` package management.
* **State & Log Archival:** Inspect local session states or export interactive history logs to standard Jupyter Notebooks, Markdown, or structured JSONL.

---

## Installation

Install the package using `uv` (recommended) or standard `pip`:

```bash
# Using uv (recommended)
uv tool install google-colab-cli

# Using pip
pip install google-colab-cli
```

---

## Quick Start

Run a CPU-based VM runtime, execute some code, and clean up:

```bash
# 1. Provision a new session
colab new

# 2. Execute code from stdin
echo 'print("Hello from Google Colab!")' | colab exec

# 3. Stop and release the VM resource
colab stop
```

> [!NOTE]
> When only one session is active, you can omit the `-s, --session` option;
> the CLI automatically knows it.


---

## Command Index

Run `colab <command> --help` to view specific options, defaults, and detailed help.

### Session Management
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab new [-s NAME] [--gpu GPU] [--tpu TPU] [--high-mem]` | Allocate a new CPU, GPU, or TPU VM runtime (optionally high-RAM) |
| `colab sessions` | List all active sessions currently active on the backend |
| `colab status [-s NAME]` | Display hardware, machine shape, status, and local metadata for active sessions |
| `colab restart-kernel [-s NAME]` | Restart the active session's Jupyter kernel |
| `colab stop [-s NAME]` | Terminate a session VM and release its resources |
| `colab url [-s NAME] [--open]` | Print or open a browser URL connecting to the active session |

### Execution
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab run [--gpu GPU] [--tpu TPU] [--high-mem] [--keep] SCRIPT [ARGS...]` | Run a local script on a fresh VM, forwarding arguments, then release it |
| `colab exec [-s NAME] [-f FILE] [--output-image PATH]` | Execute Python code from stdin, a local `.py` file, or a `.ipynb` notebook |
| `colab repl [-s NAME] [--output-image PATH]` | Start an interactive Python REPL on the VM (exits cleanly on piped EOF) |
| `colab ssh [-s NAME] [--proxy-mode] [-i KEY] [--gpu GPU] [--tpu TPU] [--high-mem] [-- CMD ...]` | Open an SSH shell to the runtime over WebSocket, run a one-shot remote command (`-- CMD`), or act as an OpenSSH `ProxyCommand` bridge for IDE remote-dev |

### File Operations
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab ls [-s NAME] [PATH]` | List remote files on the VM |
| `colab upload [-s NAME] LOCAL REMOTE` | Upload a local file to the VM filesystem |
| `colab download [-s NAME] REMOTE LOCAL` | Download a remote file from the VM filesystem |
| `colab rm [-s NAME] PATH` | Delete a remote file on the VM filesystem |
| `colab edit [-s NAME] PATH` | Edit a remote file in-place using your local `$EDITOR` |

### Automation & Utilities
| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `colab auth [-s NAME]` | Authenticate the VM for GCP services (BigQuery, GCS, etc.) |
| `colab drivemount [-s NAME] [PATH]` | Mount Google Drive on the VM (default: `/content/drive`) |
| `colab install [-s NAME] [-r FILE \| PKG...]` | Install packages on the VM using `uv` (falls back to `pip`) |
| `colab log [-s NAME] [-n N] [-o FILE]` | View or export session history (`.ipynb`, `.md`, `.txt`, `.jsonl`) |
| `colab usage` | Show account compute-unit usage rate and balance |
| `colab pay` | Open the Colab subscription page to manage compute units |
| `colab version` | Print the installed version of the CLI |
| `colab update [--install]` | Check for a newer release (and optionally upgrade the CLI in place) |

### Global Options
* `--auth {oauth2,adc}` — Authentication strategy for the Colab API (default: `adc`).
* `-c, --client-oauth-config PATH` — Path to public OAuth client credentials configuration (default: `~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json`).
* `--config PATH` — Path to local session metadata storage (default: `~/.config/colab-cli/sessions.json`).
* `--logtostderr` — Direct debug logging output to stderr.

---

## Practical Examples

### Accelerator Training with Checkpoint Retrieval

Provision an A100 GPU, install requirements, run a local training script, retrieve the resulting model weights, and terminate the VM:

```bash
colab new -s trainer --gpu A100
colab install -s trainer torch transformers
colab exec -s trainer -f train.py
colab download -s trainer checkpoints/model.bin ./model.bin
colab stop -s trainer
```

### Workspace Notebook Execution with Drive Integration

Mount Google Drive, run a local notebook against the VM kernel (outputs are written back into `report_output.ipynb`), export a Markdown log of the execution, and clean up:

```bash
colab new -s analysis
colab drivemount -s analysis
colab exec -s analysis -f report.ipynb
colab log -s analysis -o execution_log.md
colab stop -s analysis
```

---

## Usage Notes

* **Machine shape:** Use `--high-mem` with `colab new`, `colab run`, or `colab ssh` (when auto-creating a runtime) to request a high-RAM machine shape. Requires Colab Pro or Pro+ entitlement for supported accelerators (CPU, T4, A100, etc.). L4 and TPU runtimes ignore this flag because they only offer one shape. Machine shape is shown in `colab sessions` and `colab status`.
* **TTY Requirements:** `colab repl` and interactive `colab ssh` expect a local TTY. When running inside automated scripts or pipelines, pipe stdin to `colab repl` (e.g., `echo "print(1)" | colab repl`) to trigger its non-interactive mode, or run one-shot shell commands with `colab ssh -s NAME -- CMD` (e.g., `colab ssh -s NAME -- ls /content`); pass untrusted values as separate arguments (after `--` where the program accepts it), since a single argument is a remote shell line. `colab ssh` needs a local `ssh` client and key, so where it can't work (no client or key, a tool not on the minimal ssh environment's `PATH`, or the runtime's concurrent SSH connections in use), pipe the commands to `colab exec` with IPython's `!` prefix (e.g., `echo '!ls /content' | colab exec`); each `!` line is its own shell and IPython expands `{expr}` and `$name` in it, so start a multi-line script with `%%bash` and keep untrusted text out of `!` lines.
* **Transparent Code Execution:** When calling `colab exec -f file.py`, the CLI reads the file locally and transmits its content to the remote kernel. You do not need to manually upload files before execution.
* **Storage & State Paths:** Session tokens and metadata are stored at `~/.config/colab-cli/sessions.json`. Global CLI settings are located at `~/.config/colab-cli/settings.json`. These can be customized or isolated via the global `--config` flag.

### Ephemeral Accelerator Jobs

Use `colab run` to run a local script on dedicated hardware without manual session lifecycle management. The CLI handles provisioning, script execution, and immediate VM teardown automatically:

```bash
# Run train.py on a T4 GPU and release the VM on completion
colab run --gpu T4 train.py
```

### Shebang Execution Support

To execute a local file directly on a remote accelerator, place the `colab run` interpreter in the shebang line:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env -S colab run --gpu L4 --keep
import torch

print("L4 GPU Available:", torch.cuda.is_available())
print("Device Name:", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))
```

Make the script executable (`chmod +x script.py`) and run it: `./script.py`. The `--keep` option tells the CLI to preserve the session VM on completion so you can re-execute or inspect logs.

---

## Deep Dive Documentation

For comprehensive architectural overviews and deep-dives into specific CLI sub-systems, refer to the detailed documentation:

* [Session Management Architecture](docs/01_session_management.md)
* [Interactive & Non-Interactive Execution Design](docs/02_execution_and_interactive.md)
* [File Management & Jupyter Contents API](docs/03_file_management.md)
* [Authentication Providers & VM Automation](docs/04_automation_and_utility.md)
* [Ephemeral Job Runner Design](docs/05_run_command.md)

To view interactive walkthroughs of eleven real-world automated scenarios, check out the [Demo Walkthroughs](docs/demos.md).

---

## Contributing

Feedback and contributions are welcome! Please read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.

---

## Legal & Privacy

See Colab's [Terms of Service](https://research.google.com/colaboratory/tos_v6.html) and the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy), which apply to usage of this CLI.

---
name: colab-native-cli
description: 使用 Rust Colab CLI 管理多账户、会话、文件、远端执行和 DriveFS。
---

# Colab 原生 CLI

本地只需 colab 二进制；Python 代码在远端 Colab VM 执行。用 `colab help COMMAND` 查看已安装版本的参数，`colab readme` 阅读内嵌说明。

## 账户和认证

`account add NAME` 默认登录、尝试独立 Drive 授权并切 active；离线初始化必须使用 `--configure-only`。`--url-only` 只准备计算授权，后续 `login --code` 如需 Drive 应显式加 `--with-drive`。`--no-drive` 跳过 Drive，`--no-use` 保留 active。add 的普通 Drive 失败为警告，login 显式 Drive 失败返回非零；计算授权可能已经保存，应核对状态再重试。

- `colab account list --json`、`account current --json` 查询本地配置。
- `colab account status --json` 联网查询全部账户的余额和会话，不受 -a/COLAB_ACCOUNT 单账户选择限制。逐行检查 error；退出 0 允许部分失败，drive_ready 仅表示 Drive 凭据文件存在。
- 用 `-a PROFILE` 或 COLAB_ACCOUNT 选择计算账户；显式账户优先。不要修改进程环境切换其他任务的身份。
- 首次授权需用户同意：`colab -a PROFILE account login --url-only`，随后同一账户用 `account login --code CODE` 完成。
- `colab whoami --json` 会刷新所选 OAuth/ADC 并查询 Google 身份；`colab ext doctor --json` 只读本地配置，不请求 Google 或钥匙串。
- ADC 当前支持 authorized_user、service_account（未加密 PKCS#8 RSA）和 impersonated_service_account（内嵌前两种来源，可带 IAM delegates）。external_account 支持文件/URL 主体、STS 和可选 IAM 目标；external_account_authorized_user 支持 Workforce 用户 STS Basic 刷新，轮换仅在 provider 内存，不回写 gcloud。不支持递归 impersonation、domain-wide subject、证书来源或 metadata mTLS。无显式 ADC 且默认 gcloud 文件缺失时才允许 metadata 发现，可用 NO_GCE_CHECK=true 禁用；坏文件不能降级为机器身份。可执行来源只在 Unix 且显式 GOOGLE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ALLOW_EXECUTABLES=1 时运行，非交互、默认30秒、输出受限；doctor 不执行。AWS aws1 支持启动时环境快照和 EC2 IMDSv1/v2；仅生成并发送签名主体给 Google STS，不直接调用 AWS STS，不记录 key 或签名主体。取 token 成功不代表 Colab 接受该身份。不要输出、提交或写入脚本日志的 token、授权码、client secret、私钥或 JWT assertion。

## 会话、文件和执行

```sh
colab -a compute new -s work --json
colab -a compute sessions --json
colab -a compute url -s work
colab -a compute upload script.py content/script.py -s work
colab -a compute exec -s work -f script.py
colab -a compute download content/result.json result.json -s work
colab -a compute stop -s work
```

未指定账户时，可按唯一会话归属路由；歧义时必须显式指定。`sessions/status/usage --all --json` 汇总多个账户，不能把部分失败当作全部成功。

exec/REPL 复用正常 kernel，run 使用新 VM 并默认清理。`run --keep` 才保留 VM。脚本参数放在脚本路径之后，`--` 后的参数属于脚本。交互 SSH、一次性命令和 proxy 支持不同的创建/清理策略，先核对 `ssh --help`。

连接断开可能表示执行结果未知。先检查 status/kernels/待恢复记录，不重放未知代码、不自动创建替代 VM。长期运行、自动重建和任务检查点由用户脚本或外部调度器决定，CLI 不承诺无限保活。

## 独立 DriveFS

```sh
colab -a storage drive consent --url-only
colab -a storage drive consent --code CODE
colab -a compute account set-drive storage
colab -a compute drive mount -s work --dry-run
colab -a compute drive mount -s work --readonly
colab -a compute drive status -s work --json
colab -a compute drive umount -s work --json
```

根命令 `drivemount` 默认使用同一 DriveFS 编排；自动化加 `--no-fallback`。`--upstream` 显式选择计算账户的官方 Colab 授权流程，不能与跨 Drive 账户或 DriveFS 专用参数组合，也不能覆盖有恢复责任的路径。缺少凭据时仅普通交互终端可自动回退；发送后失败或结果未知不会换策略。默认等待 30 秒。

计算 OAuth 与 Drive 凭据分开。DriveFS 要求完整 drive scope 和 Gaia ID，drive.file 不足。支持环境来源和实验性 --cli-token，挂载前预览参数；不要把 token 放入 --drive-extra。

卸载会回收轮换凭据并确认远端清理。保留 active 租约时不得绕过保护更换凭据、重命名或强制删除账户。只在确认 VM 已释放后，使用 `drive lease-cleanup --endpoint ENDPOINT` 清理匹配租约；它不能从已销毁 VM 回收 token。

## 恢复与证据

`ext doctor --json` 列出本地待恢复责任，`account repair` 恢复账户事务；不要手删日志绕过保护。automation-cleanup 和 drive probe-cleanup 仅用于核实归属后的 kernel 清理，不清除用户普通 kernel。

真实测试只清理本次创建的资源。离线测试不能证明 Google 授权、DriveFS/FUSE 或原生凭据库互通；遇到未知结果应保留现场并说明证据边界。

原生更新使用 `update --manifest URL` 检查，显式 `--install` 才替换文件；源可由 COLAB_CLI_UPDATE_MANIFEST 配置。只使用可信发行源，校验后会执行发行物的 version。`update --status` 离线核查，`update --rollback` 恢复一代备份；存在待恢复操作时先核查，禁止删除更新日志绕过保护。GitHub 仓库为 https://github.com/deluxebear/colabcli-rust，Release 尚未发布；发行构建可内嵌公开清单地址。

`--show-completion SHELL` 只输出静态补全，不访问账户或 VM；`--install-completion` 会写用户 shell 配置，自动化应按用户明确需要使用。`drive status --drive-account PROFILE` 的 drive_account 是本地所选存储账户，local_credentials_present 仅表示文件存在，不证明凭据有效或与远端挂载身份一致。

`account list --json` 的 accounts 是数组；`current --json` 包含账户/Drive 来源和路径。auth.ready 仅说明本地文件存在状态；auto/keyring 无文件时为 null，离线清单不会打开钥匙串。不要将该摘要当作线上认证验证。

新建 file 模式账户 rename/remove 不访问钥匙串，也不删除原有钥匙串槽。repair 按事务中记录的策略恢复；没有策略字段的旧事务仍按双后端处理，切换到 file 不能绕过其保护。变更会保留账户顺序，删除 active 时选择首个剩余账户；这些命令只处理本地状态，不停止 VM。

账户清单与 use/set-drive/rename/remove 会先校验根级账户选择。set-drive 的根级 -a 与局部 -a 独立：前者必须有效，后者可覆盖绑定目标。重复根级 -a 取最后值；空根级值回退到 COLAB_ACCOUNT 或 active，账户环境变量会修剪首尾空白。

sessions/usage --json 的顶层是账户对象，--all --json 是账户数组；会话在 assignments，用量在 usage。即使账户认证或网络失败也可能退出 0，必须检查 error；无效全局选择和命令级配置错误仍非零。需要本地 kernel/执行详情时使用 status --json。--all 使用各账户自己的凭据，合法全局 -a 不限制查询范围。

---
name: colab-operator
description: Operate Google Colab environments via the `colab` CLI. Use when asked to create or manage GPU/TPU sessions, run Python/shell on a remote Colab VM, sync files, automate environment setup (packages, auth, Drive), or export session history.
---

# Skill: Colab Session Operator

Operate Google Colab environments via the `colab` CLI: provision GPU/TPU sessions, run Python/shell on the VM, sync files, and capture work as notebooks.

## Installation

If the user does not already have the `colab` tool installed, it can be acquired
by running `uv tool install google-colab-cli` or `pip install google-colab-cli`.

## When to activate
- Creating or managing TPU/GPU sessions.
- Running Python or shell on a remote Colab VM.
- Syncing files between local and remote.
- Automating environment setup (packages, auth, Drive).
- Exporting session history as a Jupyter notebook.

## Mental model (read this first)
- **A session == a live Jupyter kernel on a rented VM.** `colab new` allocates a billable VM; `colab stop` releases it. Sessions stay alive as long as the kernel is active, with the Colab backend automatically maintaining liveness.
- **Kernel state PERSISTS across `colab exec` / `colab repl` calls in the same session.** Each invocation reattaches to the *same* kernel (the kernel ID is cached in local state) and only closes the websocket on exit — it does **not** shut the kernel down. So imports, variables, and defined functions survive between separate `colab exec` commands. Build up state incrementally; don't re-import everything each call. (`colab stop` and `colab restart-kernel` are what actually reset it.)
- **Default working directory is `/content`.** Every `exec`/`repl`/`run` `cd`s there first; prefer absolute paths (`/content/...`) for file work. For `colab ls/rm/upload/download`, absolute `/content/...` paths work and the default `ls` path is `content` (VM root).
- **`colab` is fire-and-forget.** Each command authenticates, does one thing, and exits.

## Authentication (the #1 thing that blocks agents)
- The global flag is `--auth={adc,oauth2}` and the **default is `adc`** (Application Default Credentials). It must come *before* the subcommand: `colab --auth=adc new -s x`.
- **ADC setup** (most reliable for headless/agent use). The Colab backends need a specific scope set, so re-mint ADC with all four scopes:
  ```bash
  gcloud auth application-default login \
    --scopes=openid,\
  https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform,\
  https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email,\
  https://www.googleapis.com/auth/colaboratory
  ```
  Why all four: `userinfo.email` (session backend `colab.research.google.com`, else 401), `colaboratory` (Colab features/APIs), `openid`+`cloud-platform` (mandated by gcloud itself; it rejects scope lists missing `cloud-platform`).
- **oauth2 setup**: `colab --auth=oauth2 <anything>` triggers a browser consent flow on first use (token cached in the OS keyring via `keyring`). Requires a client config at `~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json` (or `-c PATH`), falling back to the bundled config. The browser step means it usually needs a human; prefer ADC for agents.
- **Verify auth in one shot**: `colab sessions` (read-only, lists server assignments) or `colab whoami` (hidden debug command: prints the active email, scopes, audience, and expiry). When any call 401s or 403s, the cause is almost always missing credentials or scopes — `colab whoami` shows it instantly.
- **Do NOT confuse `colab auth` with CLI authentication.** `colab auth` injects *VM-side* GCP credentials into the running kernel (so notebook code can call BigQuery/GCS); it is orthogonal to how the CLI itself authenticates. Never suggest "run `colab auth`" to fix a CLI 401/403 — that's a scope/identity problem fixed via the `gcloud` command above.

## Workflow

### Provision
- `colab new -s <name>` (CPU). Add `--gpu A100` or `--tpu v6e1` for accelerators. **Always pass `-s <name>`** — an omitted name is auto-generated as a random 6-hex string, which makes later commands ambiguous.
- Supported `--gpu`: `T4`, `L4`, `G4`, `H100`, `A100`. Supported `--tpu`: `v5e1`, `v6e1`.
- **Gotcha**: an unrecognized `--gpu` value silently falls back to **A100** (which then usually fails the next step). A `400` on `colab new` with an accelerator means no quota/entitlement for it on this account — fall back to `--gpu T4` or omit the flag for CPU.
- Accelerator availability is tier-gated; most accounts can only get CPU. Don't assume a GPU/TPU will allocate.

### Execute
- **Preferred**: `colab exec -s <name> -f <script.py>` runs a local script on the remote VM (read locally, sent to the kernel — no manual upload needed).
- **Piped code**: `echo "print(1)" | colab exec -s <name>` or `cat script.py | colab exec -s <name>`.
- **Notebooks**: `colab exec -s <name> -f nb.ipynb` runs each code cell and writes results to `<basename>_output.ipynb` next to the input. A `# @title Foo` first line labels the cell in progress output.
- **Plots/images**: PNG/JPEG outputs are intercepted. Use `--output-image <path>` on `exec`/`repl` to save to a known location (otherwise a temp path is printed). Inline terminal-image escapes are auto-suppressed when stdout isn't a TTY, so piped/captured output stays clean.
- **Shell**: run a one-shot shell command with `colab ssh -s <name> -- <cmd>`: it runs in `/content` and exits with the command's status. Output is byte-exact when stdout is piped or redirected; ssh allocates a PTY only when stdin and stdout are both terminals, so a shell tool that runs commands in a terminal should add `</dev/null` and redirect the output to a file (a pipe keeps `colab ssh`'s exit status only under `set -o pipefail`). One argument is a shell command line (quote it for pipes or globs: `colab ssh -s <name> -- 'nvidia-smi | head -5'`); several arguments are an exact argv, so pass untrusted values as separate arguments after `--` where the program accepts it (e.g. `colab ssh -s <name> -- ls -- "$f"`), never inside a shell line or a piped script. Pipe a multi-line script to `colab ssh -s <name> -- bash`. Use `colab exec` for Python code. When ssh can't work (no local `ssh` client, no `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` or `id_ecdsa` key and no `-i KEY`, a tool not on the minimal ssh environment's `PATH` such as `gcloud` or `node`, or the runtime's limited concurrent SSH connections in use, which the server answers with 429, e.g. while a person or an IDE is connected), fall back to `exec` with IPython's `!` prefix: `echo '!df -h /content' | colab exec -s <name>` (single quotes stop your local shell expanding `!`). Each `!` line runs in its own shell with no input (a command that prompts hangs), and IPython evaluates `{expr}` as Python even inside quotes and expands `$name` outside single quotes. Start a multi-line script with a `%%bash` line (not with `--env`, which prepends Python lines), use non-interactive flags such as `apt-get -y`, and never put untrusted text in a `%%bash` script or a `!` line (even via `{var}` or `$var`): pass it with `--env NAME=VALUE` and run `subprocess.run(["cmd", "--", os.environ["NAME"]])` from Python. For an interactive shell on the VM, a human runs `colab ssh -s <name>`.
- **Never run `colab repl`, `colab ssh` without `-- CMD`, `colab auth`, or `colab drivemount` interactively from an agent** — `repl`, `auth` and `drivemount` expect a TTY and will hang or fail, and bare `colab ssh` with no saved session creates a billable runtime; an interactive shell is for a human. `repl` accepts piped stdin and exits on EOF; `auth`/`drivemount` genuinely require a human at the terminal.

### Ephemeral one-shot jobs (`colab run`)
- `colab run [--gpu T4] [--tpu v6e1] [--keep] [-s NAME] script.py [args...]` = `new` + `exec` + `stop` in one command. It provisions a fresh VM, runs the script with `sys.argv` and `__name__ == "__main__"` set like native `python script.py args`, then tears the VM down (unless `--keep`).
- **Exit codes propagate**: an uncaught exception or `sys.exit(N)` in the script makes `colab run` exit non-zero (CPython semantics: `sys.exit()`/`sys.exit(0)` → 0, `sys.exit(N)` → N, `sys.exit("msg")` → 1).
- **Stream separation**: `colab run` writes its own `[colab] ...` chatter to **stderr** and the script's output to **stdout** — so `colab run job.py > out.txt` captures only the script's stdout. (`colab exec` streams the script's stdout/stderr live to your stdout/stderr.)
- Works as a shebang: `#!/usr/bin/env -S colab run --gpu T4` makes a `chmod +x`'d `.py` a self-contained "rent a GPU, run, clean up" script. After editing CLI behavior, reinstall before testing shebangs — they resolve `colab` via `$PATH`, not the editable install.
- A nonexistent script path exits non-zero **before** allocating a VM (no wasted compute).

### Automate
- `colab auth -s <name>` — VM-side GCP creds, needed before in-VM GCS/BigQuery calls (interactive; not agent-runnable).
- `colab drivemount -s <name> [PATH]` — mounts Drive at `/content/drive` by default (interactive; not agent-runnable).
- `colab install -s <name> pkg1 pkg2` — installs via `uv pip install --system`, falling back to `pip`. Also `colab install -s <name> -r requirements.txt`.

### Inspect & report
- `colab help` (or `colab help <cmd>`) lists/explains commands; the listing is alphabetical.
- `colab sessions` lists server-side assignments and auto-prunes stale local entries. Orphans with no local record show as `[?]`.
- `colab status [-s <name>]` shows hardware, IDLE/BUSY, and last execution.
- `colab log -s <name> [-n 20] [-t TYPE]` shows recent structured events; invaluable when a task fails.
- `colab log -s <name> -o summary.ipynb` exports the session as a notebook (also `.md`, `.txt`, `.jsonl` by suffix).
- `colab url -s <name>` prints a browser URL that attaches the Colab web UI to your existing CLI session instead of allocating a new VM (add `--open` to launch it).
- `colab skill` / `colab readme` print this skill and the README (handy for self-discovery).

## Safety
- **Always `colab stop -s <name>` when done** — idle VMs burn compute units. `colab run` (without `--keep`) self-cleans even if the script errors.
- Local state lives in `~/.config/colab-cli/sessions.json` (settings in `settings.json`, history in `history/*.jsonl`). Don't edit by hand.
- **Isolate parallel/agent runs** with the global `--config <path>` flag to point session state at a scratch file (e.g. `colab --config /tmp/agent.json new -s job`).

- "Session not found" / 404 / 401 on exec: the backend pruned the VM. `colab exec`/`repl` detect this and clean up local state automatically — run `colab sessions` and re-create with `colab new`.
- Execution timeout or wedged kernel: `colab restart-kernel -s <name>` (keeps the VM, resets the kernel), or `colab stop` then `colab new`.

---
name: colab-native-cli
description: 使用 Rust Colab CLI 管理多账户、会话、文件、远端执行和 DriveFS。
---

# Colab 原生 CLI

本地只需 colab 二进制；Python 代码在远端 Colab VM 执行。用 `colab help COMMAND` 查看已安装版本的参数，`colab readme` 阅读内嵌说明。

## 账户和认证

`account add NAME` 默认登录、尝试独立 Drive 授权并切 active；离线初始化必须使用 `--configure-only`。`--url-only` 只准备计算授权，后续 `login --code` 如需 Drive 应显式加 `--with-drive`。`--no-drive` 跳过 Drive，`--no-use` 保留 active。add 的普通 Drive 失败为警告，login 显式 Drive 失败返回非零；计算授权可能已经保存，应核对状态再重试。

- `colab account list --json`、`account current --json` 查询本地配置。
- `colab account status --json` 联网查询全部账户的余额和会话，不受 -a/COLAB_ACCOUNT 单账户选择限制。逐行检查 error；退出 0 允许部分失败，drive_ready 仅表示 Drive 凭据文件存在。
- 用 `-a PROFILE` 或 COLAB_ACCOUNT 选择计算账户；显式账户优先。不要修改进程环境切换其他任务的身份。
- 首次授权需用户同意：`colab -a PROFILE account login --url-only`，随后同一账户用 `account login --code CODE` 完成。
- `colab whoami --json` 会刷新所选 OAuth/ADC 并查询 Google 身份；`colab ext doctor --json` 只读本地配置，不请求 Google 或钥匙串。
- ADC 当前支持 authorized_user、service_account（未加密 PKCS#8 RSA）和 impersonated_service_account（内嵌前两种来源，可带 IAM delegates）。external_account 支持文件/URL 主体、STS 和可选 IAM 目标；external_account_authorized_user 支持 Workforce 用户 STS Basic 刷新，轮换仅在 provider 内存，不回写 gcloud。不支持递归 impersonation、domain-wide subject、证书来源或 metadata mTLS。无显式 ADC 且默认 gcloud 文件缺失时才允许 metadata 发现，可用 NO_GCE_CHECK=true 禁用；坏文件不能降级为机器身份。可执行来源只在 Unix 且显式 GOOGLE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ALLOW_EXECUTABLES=1 时运行，非交互、默认30秒、输出受限；doctor 不执行。AWS aws1 支持启动时环境快照和 EC2 IMDSv1/v2；仅生成并发送签名主体给 Google STS，不直接调用 AWS STS，不记录 key 或签名主体。取 token 成功不代表 Colab 接受该身份。不要输出、提交或写入脚本日志的 token、授权码、client secret、私钥或 JWT assertion。

## 会话、文件和执行

```sh
colab -a compute new -s work --json
colab -a compute sessions --json
colab -a compute url -s work
colab -a compute upload script.py content/script.py -s work
colab -a compute exec -s work -f script.py
colab -a compute download content/result.json result.json -s work
colab -a compute stop -s work
```

未指定账户时，可按唯一会话归属路由；歧义时必须显式指定。`sessions/status/usage --all --json` 汇总多个账户，不能把部分失败当作全部成功。

exec/REPL 复用正常 kernel，run 使用新 VM 并默认清理。`run --keep` 才保留 VM。脚本参数放在脚本路径之后，`--` 后的参数属于脚本。交互 SSH、一次性命令和 proxy 支持不同的创建/清理策略，先核对 `ssh --help`。

连接断开可能表示执行结果未知。先检查 status/kernels/待恢复记录，不重放未知代码、不自动创建替代 VM。长期运行、自动重建和任务检查点由用户脚本或外部调度器决定，CLI 不承诺无限保活。

## 独立 DriveFS

```sh
colab -a storage drive consent --url-only
colab -a storage drive consent --code CODE
colab -a compute account set-drive storage
colab -a compute drive mount -s work --dry-run
colab -a compute drive mount -s work --readonly
colab -a compute drive status -s work --json
colab -a compute drive umount -s work --json
```

根命令 `drivemount` 默认使用同一 DriveFS 编排；自动化加 `--no-fallback`。`--upstream` 显式选择计算账户的官方 Colab 授权流程，不能与跨 Drive 账户或 DriveFS 专用参数组合，也不能覆盖有恢复责任的路径。缺少凭据时仅普通交互终端可自动回退；发送后失败或结果未知不会换策略。默认等待 30 秒。

计算 OAuth 与 Drive 凭据分开。DriveFS 要求完整 drive scope 和 Gaia ID，drive.file 不足。支持环境来源和实验性 --cli-token，挂载前预览参数；不要把 token 放入 --drive-extra。

卸载会回收轮换凭据并确认远端清理。保留 active 租约时不得绕过保护更换凭据、重命名或强制删除账户。只在确认 VM 已释放后，使用 `drive lease-cleanup --endpoint ENDPOINT` 清理匹配租约；它不能从已销毁 VM 回收 token。

## 恢复与证据

`ext doctor --json` 列出本地待恢复责任，`account repair` 恢复账户事务；不要手删日志绕过保护。automation-cleanup 和 drive probe-cleanup 仅用于核实归属后的 kernel 清理，不清除用户普通 kernel。

真实测试只清理本次创建的资源。离线测试不能证明 Google 授权、DriveFS/FUSE 或原生凭据库互通；遇到未知结果应保留现场并说明证据边界。

原生更新使用 `update --manifest URL` 检查，显式 `--install` 才替换文件；源可由 COLAB_CLI_UPDATE_MANIFEST 配置。只使用可信发行源，校验后会执行发行物的 version。`update --status` 离线核查，`update --rollback` 恢复一代备份；存在待恢复操作时先核查，禁止删除更新日志绕过保护。GitHub 仓库为 https://github.com/deluxebear/colabcli-rust，Release 尚未发布；发行构建可内嵌公开清单地址。

`--show-completion SHELL` 只输出静态补全，不访问账户或 VM；`--install-completion` 会写用户 shell 配置，自动化应按用户明确需要使用。`drive status --drive-account PROFILE` 的 drive_account 是本地所选存储账户，local_credentials_present 仅表示文件存在，不证明凭据有效或与远端挂载身份一致。

`account list --json` 的 accounts 是数组；`current --json` 包含账户/Drive 来源和路径。auth.ready 仅说明本地文件存在状态；auto/keyring 无文件时为 null，离线清单不会打开钥匙串。不要将该摘要当作线上认证验证。

新建 file 模式账户 rename/remove 不访问钥匙串，也不删除原有钥匙串槽。repair 按事务中记录的策略恢复；没有策略字段的旧事务仍按双后端处理，切换到 file 不能绕过其保护。变更会保留账户顺序，删除 active 时选择首个剩余账户；这些命令只处理本地状态，不停止 VM。

账户清单与 use/set-drive/rename/remove 会先校验根级账户选择。set-drive 的根级 -a 与局部 -a 独立：前者必须有效，后者可覆盖绑定目标。重复根级 -a 取最后值；空根级值回退到 COLAB_ACCOUNT 或 active，账户环境变量会修剪首尾空白。

sessions/usage --json 的顶层是账户对象，--all --json 是账户数组；会话在 assignments，用量在 usage。即使账户认证或网络失败也可能退出 0，必须检查 error；无效全局选择和命令级配置错误仍非零。需要本地 kernel/执行详情时使用 status --json。--all 使用各账户自己的凭据，合法全局 -a 不限制查询范围。

# Skill: Colab Session Operator

If the user does not already have the `colab` tool installed, it can be acquired

## When to activate
- Creating or managing TPU/GPU sessions.
- Running Python or shell on a remote Colab VM.
- Syncing files between local and remote.
- Automating environment setup (packages, auth, Drive).
- Exporting session history as a Jupyter notebook.

## Mental model (read this first)
- **A session == a live Jupyter kernel on a rented VM.** `colab new` allocates a billable VM; `colab stop` releases it. Sessions stay alive as long as the kernel is active, with the Colab backend automatically maintaining liveness.
- **Kernel state PERSISTS across `colab exec` / `colab repl` calls in the same session.** Each invocation reattaches to the *same* kernel (the kernel ID is cached in local state) and only closes the websocket on exit — it does **not** shut the kernel down. So imports, variables, and defined functions survive between separate `colab exec` commands. Build up state incrementally; don't re-import everything each call. (`colab stop` and `colab restart-kernel` are what actually reset it.)
- **Default working directory is `/content`.** Every `exec`/`repl`/`run` `cd`s there first; prefer absolute paths (`/content/...`) for file work. For `colab ls/rm/upload/download`, absolute `/content/...` paths work and the default `ls` path is `content` (VM root).
- **`colab` is fire-and-forget.** Each command authenticates, does one thing, and exits.

## Authentication (the #1 thing that blocks agents)
- The global flag is `--auth={adc,oauth2}` and the **default is `adc`** (Application Default Credentials). It must come *before* the subcommand: `colab --auth=adc new -s x`.
- **ADC setup** (most reliable for headless/agent use). The Colab backends need a specific scope set, so re-mint ADC with all four scopes:
  ```bash
  gcloud auth application-default login \
    --scopes=openid,\
  https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform,\
  https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email,\
  https://www.googleapis.com/auth/colaboratory
  ```
  Why all four: `userinfo.email` (session backend `colab.research.google.com`, else 401), `colaboratory` (Colab features/APIs), `openid`+`cloud-platform` (mandated by gcloud itself; it rejects scope lists missing `cloud-platform`).
- **oauth2 setup**: `colab --auth=oauth2 <anything>` triggers a browser consent flow on first use (token cached in the OS keyring via `keyring`). Requires a client config at `~/.colab-cli-oauth-config.json` (or `-c PATH`), falling back to the bundled config. The browser step means it usually needs a human; prefer ADC for agents.
- **Verify auth in one shot**: `colab sessions` (read-only, lists server assignments) or `colab whoami` (hidden debug command: prints the active email, scopes, audience, and expiry). When any call 401s or 403s, the cause is almost always missing credentials or scopes — `colab whoami` shows it instantly.
- **Do NOT confuse `colab auth` with CLI authentication.** `colab auth` injects *VM-side* GCP credentials into the running kernel (so notebook code can call BigQuery/GCS); it is orthogonal to how the CLI itself authenticates. Never suggest "run `colab auth`" to fix a CLI 401/403 — that's a scope/identity problem fixed via the `gcloud` command above.

## Workflow

### Provision
- `colab new -s <name>` (CPU). Add `--gpu A100` or `--tpu v6e1` for accelerators. **Always pass `-s <name>`** — an omitted name is auto-generated as a random 6-hex string, which makes later commands ambiguous.

- **Gotcha**: an unrecognized `--gpu` value silently falls back to **A100** (which then usually fails the next step). A `400` on `colab new` with an accelerator means no quota/entitlement for it on this account — fall back to `--gpu T4` or omit the flag for CPU.
- Accelerator availability is tier-gated; most accounts can only get CPU. Don't assume a GPU/TPU will allocate.

- **Notebooks**: `colab exec -s <name> -f nb.ipynb` runs each code cell and writes results to `<basename>_output.ipynb` next to the input. A `# @title Foo` first line labels the cell in progress output.
- **Plots/images**: PNG/JPEG outputs are intercepted. Use `--output-image <path>` on `exec`/`repl` to save to a known location (otherwise a temp path is printed). Inline terminal-image escapes are auto-suppressed when stdout isn't a TTY, so piped/captured output stays clean.
- **Shell**: run a one-shot shell command with `colab ssh -s <name> -- <cmd>`: it runs in `/content` and exits with the command's status. # Print an optspec for argparse to handle cmd's options that are independent of any subcommand.
function __fish_colab_global_optspecs
    string join \n config-dir= a/account= auth= colab-runtime-endpoint= c/client-oauth-config= token-storage= keyring-timeout= control-plane-url= request-timeout= assign-retries= retry-backoff= drive-userinfo-url= show-completion= install-completion= h/help V/version
end

function __fish_colab_needs_command
    # Figure out if the current invocation already has a command.
    set -l cmd (commandline -opc)
    set -e cmd[1]
    argparse -s (__fish_colab_global_optspecs) -- $cmd 2>/dev/null
    or return
    if set -q argv[1]
        # Also print the command, so this can be used to figure out what it is.
        echo $argv[1]
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

function __fish_colab_using_subcommand
    set -l cmd (__fish_colab_needs_command)
    test -z "$cmd"
    and return 1
    contains -- $cmd[1] $argv
end

Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName 'colab' -ScriptBlock {
    param($wordToComplete, $commandAst, $cursorPosition)

    $commandElements = $commandAst.CommandElements
    $command = @(
        'colab'
        for ($i = 1; $i -lt $commandElements.Count; $i++) {
            $element = $commandElements[$i]
            if ($element -isnot [StringConstantExpressionAst] -or
                $element.StringConstantType -ne [StringConstantType]::BareWord -or
                $element.Value.StartsWith('-') -or
                $element.Value -eq $wordToComplete) {
                break
        }
        $element.Value
    }) -join ';'

    $completions = @(switch ($command) {
        'colab' {
            [CompletionResult]::new('--config-dir', '--config-dir', [CompletionResultType]::ParameterName, 'config-dir')

            [CompletionResult]::new('--auth', '--auth', [CompletionResultType]::ParameterName, 'auth')

            [CompletionResult]::new('--assign-retries', '--assign-retries', [CompletionResultType]::ParameterName, 'assign-retries')
